title: Baalbek trilithon stones

tellings.quote: There's a series of stones called the trilithan stones, which are raised about 30 ft above the foundation blocks and placed with precision. They weigh conservative range 800 tons each, coming up to about 1,000 tons.

plain: At Baalbek in Lebanon, a set of huge blocks called the trilithon stones sits about 30 feet above the foundation blocks, placed with precision, each weighing at least 800 tons and up to about 1,000 tons. A guest named Jay Anderson describes them on Michels's show without citing a source, as a sign that whoever built the site could lift weights that are hard to explain.
